package.name: openral_hal_rizon
package.description: Real-hardware bringup for two Flexiv Rizon 4s arms driven as one robot: a dual-arm xacro over upstream flexiv_description, one upstream flexiv_hardware FlexivHardwareInterface per arm, and the controller config. The HAL node itself is the generic openral_hal_node; robots/rizon_dual/robot.yaml reaches this launch through hal.real_bringup.
